Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I am sending today a third instalment of the [Primer](../books.html#353) with additions, I hope you have had the others safely. I have sent them to you instead of the printers to save further mistakes and will follow them up with the rest

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
